name: Short-Term Rental Break-Even Calculator
description: Estimate short-term rental revenue, operating costs, monthly profit and the occupancy rate required to break even.
search_intent: Calculate Airbnb or short-term rental break-even occupancy and monthly profitability.
keywords: short term rental break even calculator
calculation: Occupied nights = available nights × occupancy fraction. Gross revenue = occupied nights × nightly rate. Platform fees = gross revenue × fee percentage. Variable costs = occupied nights × variable cost per night. Monthly profit = gross revenue − platform fees − variable costs − fixed costs. Contribution per occupied night = nightly rate × (1 − platform fee fraction) − variable cost. Break-even occupied nights = fixed costs ÷ contribution per occupied night. Break-even occupancy = break-even occupied nights ÷ available nights × 100. If contribution per occupied night is zero or negative, break-even occupancy is not applicable.
limitations: Taxes, financing, seasonality and property appreciation are not automatically included.
Occupancy and nightly rates are user assumptions.
Local short-term rental rules are not evaluated.
